::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Hosea portrays God's faithful covenant love despite Israel's spiritual unfaithfulness. The book teaches that God's redeeming love pursues His people even after repeated rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Hosea 1:2
Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms
### Why This Verse Symbolic beginning of Hosea's ministry ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces Hosea's marriage as a symbol of Israel's unfaithfulness. The key verse demonstrates God's continuing covenant purposes despite His people's rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Hosea 2:23
I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans and 1 Peter ### Chapter Insight This chapter portrays God's judgment and future restoration of Israel. The key verse reveals God's desire to draw His people back into loving relationship with Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Hosea 3:1
Love a woman beloved of her friend
### Why This Verse Picture of redeeming love ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Hosea's redemption of his unfaithful wife. The key verse illustrates God's redeeming love toward His wayward people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Hosea 4:6
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge
### Why This Verse One of Hosea's most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter accuses Israel of lacking knowledge of God. The key verse warns that spiritual destruction results from rejecting God's truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Hosea 5:15
In their affliction they will seek Me early
### Why This Verse Repentance theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon Israel and Judah. The key verse emphasizes that God disciplines His people to bring them to repentance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Hosea 6:6
I desired mercy, and not sacrifice
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus twice in Matthew ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls for sincere repentance and covenant faithfulness. The key verse highlights God's desire for mercy and knowledge of Him rather than empty ritual. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Hosea 7:8
Ephraim is a cake not turned
### Why This Verse Memorable image of compromise ### Chapter Insight This chapter exposes Israel's hypocrisy and political compromises. The key verse illustrates the instability that comes from divided loyalties. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Hosea 8:7
They have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns of the consequences of sowing rebellion. The key verse teaches that people reap the results of their actions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Hosea 9:17
They shall be wanderers among the nations
### Why This Verse Consequence of rebellion ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces coming judgment and exile. The key verse emphasizes the consequences of persistent unfaithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Hosea 10:12
Sow to yourselves in righteousness
### Why This Verse Call to spiritual renewal ### Chapter Insight This chapter condemns Israel's prosperity without devotion. The key verse calls God's people to seek the Lord and pursue righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Hosea 11:1
Out of Egypt have I called My son
### Why This Verse Quoted in Matthew regarding Christ ### Chapter Insight This chapter reveals God's fatherly love for Israel. The key verse expresses God's compassion even toward a rebellious people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Hosea 12:6
Turn thou to thy God
### Why This Verse Call to covenant faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This chapter reviews Israel's history and continued need for repentance. The key verse calls for steadfast love, justice, and dependence upon God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Hosea 13:14
O death, I will be thy plagues
### Why This Verse Quoted in 1 Corinthians 15 ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns of judgment resulting from idolatry. The key verse reminds Israel that God alone is their Savior. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Hosea 14:9
Who is wise, and he shall understand these things?
### Why This Verse Book's concluding wisdom statement ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes with a call to repentance and a promise of restoration. The key verse reveals God's willingness to heal and restore those who return to Him. :::
